name: Verify Updated Escalated Case for Juniper EX4300 Issue
description: This verifier confirms that the escalated case CS-0000009 has been correctly updated to reflect that work is now in progress.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer_case c
JOIN product p
  ON p.product_id = c.product_id
WHERE c.number = 'CS-0000009'
  AND c.escalation = 1
  AND c.state = 'in_progress'
  AND p.name = 'Juniper EX4300 Variant 31'
  AND c.short_description LIKE 'Product: Juniper EX4300 Variant 31,%';

name: Knowledge Article Linked to Case
description: This verifier ensures that the correct knowledge article for Juniper EX4300 Variant 31 has been linked to the escalated case CS-0000009.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM case_knowledge ck
JOIN knowledge k
  ON k.knowledge_id = 243
JOIN customer_case c
  ON c.case_id = ck.case_id
WHERE c.number = 'CS-0000009'
  AND k.title LIKE '%Juniper EX4300 Variant 31%'
  AND k.state = 'published'
  AND ck.used_as = 'applied';
